steps.text: Scary Martin Bar
(Jingle)

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Welcome...

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Help... help me!

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Get back here! Seize her!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Oh, my poor door... only just fixed the day before.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: A knight... any knight, please help me...

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Hmph, you think a knight's going to save you here?

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Look around you! It's just a run-down bar pretending it's got anything to do with knights!

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: And no knight would never pay you any attention, besides.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Someone, I'm begging you, help me, please... don't let him take me... don't let him sell me!

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: That's not for you to say. Get an earful of this, bar-goers! 'Chattel' that's already been marked up wants to flee, and wants a knight's help on top of it?

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Shout your lungs out for all I care, see who comes to save you! Get over here already!

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: No, I... I was tricked, I'm not 'chattel' or anything! I didn't want to come to Kazimierz, I want to go home...

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Ha-ha. Look at this dumb little girl from a village with no name.

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: A make-believe story tricked you, that's what. Wanting to go to Kawalerielki to be a knight? And you came right along like an idiot... that's just comedy!

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Might as well, while I'm here. Server, I'll have a glass for the road, then I'll take this girl with me, sell her to some old knight as a servant...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Sorry, friend. We don't take too kindly to hunters doing shady business 'round here.

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: ...Come again?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: You were saying we don't get knights in here. Selling our little establishment here short, I think. After all, we've got the bigshot, Sir 'Brassrust Knight' Ingra, sitting right here.

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: B-Brassrust... you mean, THAT Brassrust Knight...!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: (What? Hold on, boss, I only came here to drink. This equipment is just merch...)

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: (Glare)

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: (A—A'ight...)

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: '*belch*... *hack*. Rowdy wretch. A piffling dirt-wallowing bounty hunter thinks to cross me?'

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: 'Out of my sight.'

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Grr... hear that? Come with me, before you ruin a major Knight's day!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Psia mać, is there anyone here who can kindly show this villain to the door?

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: N-No... I don't want to go with...

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: No, no, I don't want to be someone's servant, I just want to go home... ah!

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Do licha, what's the holdup? With me, now...!

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Guh... agh...!

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Who... *cough*, *hackpth*!

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Noisy, noisy~. What's the order of the day in here?

steps.name: Strange Hunter
steps.text: Skurwysyny, sneaky asshole... ggh...!

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: And who gave you a license to stomp around Kawalerielki like that?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Phew... good we had a helping hand. Would've had a hard time saving the merchandise on my own.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: Is it... over now? B—Being a knight fan sure pays off sometimes, haha...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What, has Kawalerielki been so quick to forget me?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Marcin, I used to come here quiiiite often.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Your technique... and then your arm here... a 'barcode', is it?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I remember, now... It's you. 'Gravel'. You're a Maypole family Knight.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Gravel... Knight?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: You can call me Gravel. It's what I go by, you know. Not any kind of stiffed-up title.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: Knight? *snort*, a Knight attacking her opponent from behind. Using cheap tricks for assassins, too.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: Real knights should be like Sir Ingra, with massive strength, unstoppable force, and a name with the power to drop your guts!

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: So awkward I have to tell you this, Marcin's customer, but unlike those big stars made of money in the arena, my techniques all come from honest-to-gosh survival.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: You hate the competition knights, is that it? *snort*, all you campaign knights do is drain taxpayer money...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Break it up, break it up.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: This hunter boy's not waking up for a while. Lass, you find yourself an escape.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Right, and you haven't thanked Gravel for her bravery.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Th-Thank you so much.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: You're that Gravel, then...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Hm? Don't tell me I'm famous.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: I've-I've heard about how y-you came to our village once! A lot of bounty hunters operate close by, and it's so far from anywhere else, so the knights barely ever come to help drive them away...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Old stuff, then... I've been to plenty of places, looking for clues. That was all years ago, though.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: And you look pretty young. There's no way you could've met me back then... Who are you, hm?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: She's still in a state of shock. Don't you frighten her. Let her wind down some.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Gravel. Been a long time.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Long time and no see, Marcin. Is the master of the house still regular here these days?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hah hah, you know he's not crazy for places like this, full of people. Last I heard, he fell in the lake and broke a leg angling, and now it's been an age since he dropped by to try himself some snacks.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Perfect. I'll have a round of what he hasn't eaten.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: You're not gonna treat the lass to something?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I'm the girl who saved her life. Why am I paying for her meal on top of it?

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: G—Gravel, I...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Mmn... fine, you just sit down next to me here. Marcin, I'll have two portions.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Thank you, good Knight...!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: So, what've you come back for this time?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I'm just on vacation, seeing how the master of the house's holding up after his dive. Two days before I have to head back.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Back? Back where? You're a Knight of Kazimierz. It's wherever your family's Knight Primus lives that you go on back to.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Hmm? But I've left Kazimierz at this point...

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: Where you go, what you do, and who you want to become are all your freedom.

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: So long as you believe, your decisions will justify all that you've striven, and won't ever sully your name.

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: So go, Gravel.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: No doubt about it... I already told him about my decision, and I even gave you a goodbye.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: You oldies and your forgetfulness. I bet I fell out of your heads straight away, didn't I?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hah hah, I'm getting on in years for sure. Gets hard to remember so many things.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (...No. Marcin's reaction... something's odd about it.)

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (Something so huge happened, and now he forgets it...?)

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Gravel Knight, the 'master of the house' you mention is...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: A name to know for sure. The Maypole family's Knight Primus Gekoski. He used to be a lynchpin of a campaign knight.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The young Knights now'd have a shout in hell of investing what the Maypole family did, back in those days.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: *snort*. Don't forget, though, he's just old news now...

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: For having offended your family and Knight Primus... I apologize, Knight.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Next time, there won't be a time for sorries.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight Fan
steps.text: Uh... dgh. Boss, bill!

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Gravel Knight, is that Maypole family Knight someone... you really respect?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Mmhm, of course. It was with his blessing I didn't end up like the other 'chattel', stuck in the lowest of all work.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I could only become a Knight because of the training he gave me.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: How nice... having a chance to become a Knight. If... if I could be one too, then maybe I'd be able to return home and see my mom and dad again...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Have you been marked with a chattel serial number yet?

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: I-I haven't... I got away midway through.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That was brave of you. Well done.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Will it—make trouble for you helping me, Gravel Knight? I... I know hunters don't like being messed with...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Not to worry. Filthy business like this should've vanished long ago.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (No, more than that. In fact, it should've already completely vanished.)

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (Let's just see for now...)

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: This bounty hunter won't dare try anything with you again, and you're not currently 'chattel.' No one will get in your way. Rush back home, hm?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: I... can't actually return, Miss Gravel.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: I have no money, and besides, I don't know where my home even is...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Isn't it right in Kazimierz? Just mention the village name, and...

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: I-I'm not from here... when I was tiny, I was kidnapped and brought to a Kazimierz village.

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: Go home? Alright, where do you call home? Of all of Kazimierz's villages, which is it?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: It's... It's not...

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...I'm... not from here.

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: Then tell, young lady. Just where is it you come from?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...I... don't know.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I forgot everything.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: I—I wanted to escape, but I already forgot where I even came from...

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: And then one day, a hunter told me he could take me to find a Knight, and they'd bring me home, and if I was lucky I could become a Knight myself.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: So I was... taken to Kawalerielki. I only learned afterwards that they were planning to sell me, and make me serve someone else.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: But that's not what I want to do! I want to go home! What I heard was he could take me to find a Knight, to take me home...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Leaving Kazimierz by herself, finding her hometown and her parents, that's just asking far too much of a young kid.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Grr. I know.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (Of course I know. I couldn't be any clearer about this.)

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: That thing on your arm... isn't it a 'barcode'?

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Surely that doesn't mean, you...?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Yes... it's true.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Unlike you, I never had even the chance to flee the hunters, and I got sold straight off. My one bit of luck is the old man who bought me was beyond charitable, without a doubt.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Even so, becoming a Knight was all your own effort. From commoner to a campaign knight... anyone knows why that ain't an easy time.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: That's amazing. So you really can become one...

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: After you became a Knight, did you ever return to your home to see your parents?

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: I miss them so much. I want to see my mom and dad again...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I never found them.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I once went to a village, where you once happened to be. Maybe because I was searching for clues about those hunters, wanting to find out where they took me from.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But... I never found anything.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: No. None of this is real.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: Gravel... Knight?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Don't drag me into the whirlpool of memories again. All this is... it's what I always, always feared happening most.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: If I hadn't met the master of the house, if I hadn't become a Knight, if I'd never found my family... just what kind of state would I end up in?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But I've known, since long ago, that none of it will ever trouble my heart again.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Gravel, what are you talking about?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: And you, Marcin, you too. It could never miss you that I'd left Kazimierz, joined Rhodes Island... That's right, I came back from 'Rhodes Island.'

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: I know... Can tell from a quick look in your eyes. You've come to say farewell to me.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I'm... going to Rhodes Island. To follow them.

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: Hmph. Have you already told them your name?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Not yet. I need to confirm for myself once more, whether or not they're deceiving me, whether they want to use me for evil.

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: Then go. To that Rhodes Island to see, and continue your hometown search as you do.

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: I know... you haven't given up on finding it. It is the right thing to do, Gravel.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Father, I...

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: It is just as we said those years ago, Gravel. Go. You were to leave sooner or later. As you are decisive in this moment, so there is little to long for.

steps.name: Gekoski
steps.text: Come back to Kazimierz, should you want to come back. And should you not... then do not be burdened, and go!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: 'Rhodes Island'? Gravel, you're a Maypole family vassal, a fourth-order knight...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: All that is... the past now, Marcin. I belong to Rhodes Island now.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What this girl just told us, all of this is 'my' story.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I went unsaved by a Knight, was trafficked into Kazimierz, sold into Kawalerielki... and I didn't even know how to go about getting back home.

steps.name: Runaway Girl
steps.text: But you got your own family in Kazimierz too. As a Maypole vassal, as a Knight, you must be so happy...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I am a vassal to the master of the house. I'll forever revere him, be grateful for him.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But, the last thing he said to me... is that I shouldn't forever long for this place.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I left Kazimierz. Because I had a reason to. And it was time to find my own true home and parents.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Yes... this is all just a dream.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: And I know this, because there wouldn't ever be another child kidnapped into Kawalerielki.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Those ruthless scum dressing up in the skins of 'bounty hunters' were the last force in the trafficking business. As far back as I'd followed every village patrol and punished every hunter, they were already—

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...Unf... ugh.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (This is... Rhodes Island?)

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Yes, Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (So that really was just a dream.)

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (I've been having similar dreams, one after another, but...)

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Sorry, it looks like I... fell asleep.

options: It's alright. You seem a little shaken, anyhow.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Hehe, are you worried about me?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Funny. I'm usually the one watching you. I never imagined I'd be in another's gaze.

options: Don't get the wrong idea, it's not like I...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I understand. I know you don't get distracted at work. You're just supervising me, making sure I'm doing my job properly, aren't you?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Ah~. Anyway, don't let me weigh on you. Go on, continue with your work.

options: Actually, Gravel... if you're tired, it's alright to nap.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Hm? That'd be dereliction of duty, wouldn't it, Doctor~

options: It's not that big a deal.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: You really are cunning, Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: In Kazimierz, I'd hardly ever have the time to sleep. I'd dream so often... not that they were any good dreams.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Doctor, after losing your memory... have you ever felt helpless, or alarmed, maybe?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I do dream often. Of leaving my home, being brought to Kazimierz. I find all sorts of people to assist me, even my own dream 'me', hoping they can help me find my way home.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But the thing is, every time I'm asked where my hometown is, I just...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Even today, I still can't bring to mind where it is I came from. I only remember it was a place completely different from Kazimierz.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Poor, a backwater... fragile. The parents of mine who couldn't even protect their own child.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But no matter what, all these years and years, I've wanted always to find my home, to return and see my parents. I don't know if they're well, or if they'd still remember me.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: How lucky of me, to be picked up by that old knight, to have a fate unlike the other 'chattel', to seize knighthood by my own efforts.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But, I've never forgotten... why it is I became a Knight.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The power to seek myself, the ability to protect others. And now, I have... protecting your life as my calling.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Aw~, are you embarrassed? It's alright, Doctor, I won't guess at what you're thinking. Right now, watching your every movement is the only function of these two eyes.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Just give me this chance, let me stay by your side to defend you, and that'll be fine.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Alright, you'd better head on back to work, Doctor~. Or perhaps, you wanted to learn about me, all especially?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: It's alright, Doctor. I'll be keeping you company for a very long time. When the time comes and you want to know, I'll tell you all about my past.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I'm even freer than I was, leaving Kazimierz and coming to Rhodes Island, and it lets me keep searching for my home.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Right now... it's in quiet interactions, like these, where I can be most at peace.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Although...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (We're at the point where I can sleep in the Doctor's office... I suppose that's a little privilege of mine?)

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (Oh, right, I should invite the Doctor to go back to Kazimierz with me sometime.)

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (Heh-heh... It always feels sooo lonely in my dreams, back in Kazimierz all by myself. Aww, poor me.)

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: (Uh-oh, and here I have the spare time to think about this at work. Really... what a mess I am.)
